title: Andrew Likoudis
name: Andrew Likoudis
html: Andrew Likoudis serves as Web Developer and Technology Consultant for ICJurist.org. He is the founder of Lickity Split Web Design, the web design and technology consulting practice of Likoudis Ventures, and the Founder and President of the Likoudis Legacy Foundation, a Catholic research institute in Baltimore. He is Editor-in-Chief of The Kydones Review and the author of To His Face: Indefectibility and the Problem of Dissent (En Route Books, 2026). He holds an MA in Catholic Studies from Franciscan University of Steubenville.
